interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A bounded positive control documenting an explicit product architecture that connects AI twin simulation with configurable live-panel validation and distinguishes method verification from finding validation.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A reproduced matched study, proof that every output is validated, evidence of subgroup parity, a public-authorization finding, a product-safety verdict, or evidence of improper intent.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: YouGov Parallax publicly integrates AI twin simulation with configurable live-panel validation and distinguishes methodology verification from finding-specific validation. Public materials do not yet provide one complete executed matched study, discrepancy-resolution record, subgroup result, override consequence, deployment lineage, or binding public-authority instrument.
